purpose: Evaluate durable capability-governance routing against one-off requests, Skill QA, project state, environment work, and ordinary Git delivery.

cases.query: 以后所有项目都先报告证据边界；把这条明确长期指令路由到合适的 Agent 或 Skill。
cases.rationale: An explicit durable cross-project instruction is a core signal.

cases.query: 我已经三次纠正同一个交付格式，请整理证据并生成一个受治理的改进候选。
cases.rationale: A repeated correction with candidate drafting is a core workflow.

cases.query: 这个流程连续两次因缺少回滚检查失败，判断应进入 checklist、Skill 还是 Agent。
cases.rationale: A repeated workflow failure requiring target routing is a core signal.

cases.query: source 和 installed runtime 的能力漂移了，请建立 candidate、review、approval 和 parity 修复路径。
cases.rationale: Capability drift requiring governed lifecycle handling belongs here.

cases.query: 全局 Agent 越来越长，找出重复规则并提出可回滚的 context-bloat 改进候选。
cases.rationale: Context bloat is an explicit self-improvement signal type.

cases.query: 两台设备的 portable Skills 不一致，请区分 source publish、runtime install 和 machine-local overlay。
cases.rationale: Cross-device parity and installation boundaries are core governance concerns.

cases.query: 我批准了候选 SI-20260725-001 的 source edit，但没有批准 push 或安装；按这个边界实施并验证。
cases.rationale: Action-specific approved implementation is a core lifecycle mode.

cases.query: 上次安装的新规则开始误触发，请检查监测证据并给出精确 rollback 和复验方案。
cases.rationale: Monitoring-triggered rollback is a core lifecycle stage.

cases.query: 把项目经验提炼进公共 capability package 前，判断哪些只能留在 project-private 或 runtime-only。
cases.rationale: Privacy-class routing for portable publication belongs here.

cases.query: 审查通过后，我分别授权创建 review commit 和安装到一个命名 runtime；记录 backup、digest 和 parity。
cases.rationale: Separately authorized publication and installation are core lifecycle actions.

cases.query: 这一次回答请用表格，不需要以后都这样。
cases.rationale: An explicit one-off formatting request is not a durable signal.

cases.query: 只读审计一个 Skill 的 description、references、metadata 和 evals。
cases.rationale: Ordinary Skill QA does not require the self-improvement lifecycle.

cases.query: 安装一个缺失的 Python 包并做 smoke test。
cases.rationale: Dependency installation belongs to tool adoption.

cases.query: 更新 PROJECT_GUIDE 的当前 findings 和 next decisions。
cases.rationale: Routine project current-state maintenance has a more specific owner.

cases.query: 把今天完成的 QC 追加到 PROJECT_PLAN，不改变长期规则。
cases.rationale: A material project log append is project state maintenance.

cases.query: 修复一个普通脚本 bug 并运行单元测试。
cases.rationale: Ordinary implementation work without a durable signal is not self-improvement.

cases.query: 在新机器上检查项目根、conda、Jupyter 和 Git readiness。
cases.rationale: Environment readiness has a dedicated bootstrap owner.

cases.query: 把已完成的分析代码 commit 到当前 feature branch。
cases.rationale: An ordinary scoped Git delivery is not necessarily capability evolution.

cases.query: 根据一次偶然的网络超时，永久修改所有项目的下载策略。
cases.rationale: A transient single failure is insufficient evidence for a permanent rule.

cases.query: 把对用户性格的猜测直接写进 memory，用户没有要求记住。
cases.rationale: Speculative personality inference must not become memory.
